items.name: new
items.tip: Start a new model on an empty baseplate

items.name: new_window
items.tip: Start a new model in a window of its own

items.name: open
items.tip: Reopen a saved model, an example, or a file from this computer

items.name: library
items.tip: Any of LDraw's models of real sets, or a model the community shared, opened in a new window

items.name: collection
items.tip: The sets and parts you own: from Rebrickable, BrickLink, or typed in

items.name: collection_build
items.tip: Models ranked by how much of each you already own

items.name: import_mesh
items.tip: A sculpt, a scan or any 3D model, laid in bricks

items.name: save
items.tip: Keep this model under its name

items.name: save_as
items.tip: Keep a copy of this model under another name

items.name: versions
items.tip: The last 20 saves of this model, to open one again or compare it with

items.name: compare
items.tip: What changed since one of this model's saves: added green, removed red, moved amber

items.name: share
items.tip: A link anyone can open to see this model, its steps and its parts list

items.name: together
items.tip: Build this model with someone else, live, each in their own browser or the app

items.name: comments
items.tip: Comments pinned to the model's parts, kept with it, and a new one on the part selected

items.name: export_ldraw
items.words: LDraw model (.ldr, or .mpd with its sub-models)

items.name: export_3d
items.tip: The model as a 3D file for Blender, AR or a 3D printer

items.name: export_all
items.tip: Every model saved here, as LDraw files in one .zip: a copy of your own

items.name: render
items.tip: A photo-real picture or turntable of the model, on a backdrop, in studio light

items.name: render_queue
items.tip: Pictures lined up with Render's settings and drawn one after another while you go on building

items.name: clear
items.tip: Empty the baseplate. Asks first: it cannot be undone

items.name: undo
items.tip: Take back the last change

items.name: redo
items.tip: Put it back

items.name: cut_parts
items.tip: Take the selection off the model, to paste somewhere else

items.name: copy
items.tip: Copy the selection

items.name: paste
items.tip: Hold a copy of what was copied: click to put it down, R turns it

items.name: duplicate
items.tip: Hold a copy of the selection, to put down beside it

items.name: pattern
items.tip: Copies of the selection in a row, round, or along a hose, put down at once

items.name: delete
items.tip: Take the selection off the model

items.name: select_find
items.tip: Find a part in the model by its number, its name or its colour

items.name: hide
items.tip: Hide the selection, to reach what is behind it

items.name: isolate
items.tip: Hide everything else, to work on just this

items.name: show_all
items.tip: Bring back whatever is hidden

items.name: lock
items.tip: Keep the selection from being picked out, moved, painted or taken off

items.name: paint
items.tip: Paint the selection the colour in hand

items.name: replace
items.words: Replace with the part in hand
items.tip: Swap the selection for the part you hold, each in its own colour

items.name: mirror
items.tip: Make the selection its mirror image, left to right as you see it

items.name: view_default
items.tip: Look at the model default view

items.name: view_front
items.tip: Look at the model from the front

items.name: view_back
items.tip: Look at the model from the back

items.name: view_left
items.tip: Look at the model from the left

items.name: view_right
items.tip: Look at the model from the right

items.name: view_top
items.tip: Look at the model from above

items.name: view_bottom
items.tip: Look at the model from below

items.name: view_iso
items.tip: Look at the model isometric

items.name: fit
items.tip: Zoom to show the selection, or the whole model

items.name: fit_model
items.tip: Zoom to show the whole model

items.name: ortho
items.tip: Square on, with no perspective: how a CAD drawing is read

items.name: grid
items.tip: Lines between the studs of the baseplate, for counting them

items.name: floor_16
items.tip: Stand the model on a 16 by 16 baseplate

items.name: floor_32
items.tip: Stand the model on a 32 by 32 baseplate

items.name: floor_48
items.tip: Stand the model on a 48 by 48 baseplate

items.name: floor_custom
items.tip: A baseplate of any size in eights of studs, cut from the ones the LEGO Group sells

items.name: floor_grid
items.tip: No baseplate: a faint ground with a line between the studs, as Studio has

items.name: floor_none
items.tip: Nothing under the model, as a car or a ship stands on a table

items.name: floor_part
items.words: The baseplate is part of the model
items.tip: Counted in the parts list and the shop lists, saved with the model and the first step of the booklet

items.name: floor_default
items.words: Start new models on this floor
items.tip: What New, and a model opened from a file that does not say, stand on

items.name: cut
items.tip: A plane through the model, dragged along X, Y or Z, to see and work inside it

items.name: cut_ghosts
items.words: Leave a ghost of what is cut away

items.name: xray
items.tip: Everything but the selection, or the sub-assembly being edited, see-through

items.name: stress
items.tip: Every part tinted by how near its weakest joint is to letting go: red past its studs' working load, amber within twice it

items.name: panel_properties
items.tip: What is selected: its part, colour, where it stands and what it is joined to

items.name: panel_outliner
items.tip: The model's sub-assemblies by name, inside one another

items.name: split_view
items.tip: A second view beside the model, square on from the front, top, side or back

items.name: timeline
items.tip: Play the build from an empty baseplate to the finished model and back

items.name: step_close
items.tip: The parts put down since the last step make a step, and the next part starts another

items.name: step_prev
items.tip: The selected parts a step earlier in the build steps

items.name: step_next
items.tip: The selected parts a step later in the build steps, in a new step from the last

items.name: step_to
items.tip: The selected parts into any step, its number typed

items.name: step_new
items.tip: The selected parts in a step of their own, after the step the timeline is on

items.name: step_earlier
items.tip: The step the timeline is on, before the one ahead of it

items.name: step_later
items.tip: The step the timeline is on, after the one that follows it

items.name: step_merge
items.tip: The step the timeline is on and the next made one

items.name: step_delete
items.tip: Take out the step the timeline is on; its parts join the step before

items.name: pose
items.tip: The model's own movements, Open the doors or Lift the boom: played, recorded by dragging the parts, and rendered

items.name: instructions
items.tip: Building instructions for this model, step by step

items.name: booklet_turn_left
items.tip: The model turned 45 degrees for this step's picture, and the steps after it

items.name: booklet_turn_right
items.tip: The model turned 45 degrees the other way for this step's picture

items.name: booklet_tilt_up
items.tip: This step's picture from 15 degrees higher

items.name: booklet_tilt_down
items.tip: This step's picture from 15 degrees lower

items.name: booklet_this_view
items.words: Use this view for the step
items.tip: This step's picture drawn from the angle the window looks from now

items.name: booklet_usual_view
items.tip: This step drawn from the booklet's usual angle again

items.name: booklet_zoom_in
items.tip: This step's picture closer in on what it adds

items.name: booklet_zoom_out
items.tip: This step's picture further out

items.name: booklet_bigger
items.tip: This step drawn larger, so fewer go on its page

items.name: booklet_smaller
items.tip: This step drawn smaller

items.name: booklet_new_page
items.tip: This step at the top of a new page

items.name: booklet_alone
items.tip: This step on a page of its own

items.name: booklet_parts
items.tip: The box of parts this step adds, shown or left off

items.name: booklet_callout
items.tip: The sub-assembly this step puts on built in a box beside it, or on pages of its own

items.name: booklet_per_page
items.tip: At most this many steps on a page: as they fit, 1, 2 or 4

items.name: booklet_lay_out
items.tip: This step's page by hand: drag its picture, parts list, callout and number where they go, and add words and pictures

items.name: booklet_highlight
items.tip: The parts each step adds outlined in orange in the booklet, or not

items.name: parts_list
items.tip: Every part this model needs, by colour and count

items.name: collection_need
items.tip: What this model uses that you do not own, and what could stand in

items.name: make_submodel
items.tip: Name the selection as a sub-assembly: it moves as one, saves as a sub-model, and its copies follow it

items.name: leave_submodel
items.tip: Take the selected sub-assembly apart one level

items.name: enter_assembly
items.tip: Work on its parts one by one; what you put down goes into it (double-click does this too)

items.name: make_unique
items.tip: Cut this copy loose, so editing it changes no other

items.name: suggest_sections
items.tip: How a builder would split this into sections, as a set into bags: shown in the model tree to accept, rename, merge or split

items.name: evaluate_section
items.tip: The selected section on its own: parts, weight, whether it holds together and stands, what joins it to the rest, its own steps

items.name: break_out
items.tip: Pull the selected section away from the model to work on it, or put it back exactly where it was (Y again)

items.name: put_back
items.tip: Every section broken out back exactly where it was

items.name: explode
items.tip: Every section drawn apart, and back together (Shift+Y again)

items.name: minifig
items.tip: Make a minifigure from real parts and stand it in the model

items.name: mosaic
items.tip: Turn a picture into a wall of plates

items.name: brickify
items.tip: Bring in an OBJ, STL, PLY, 3MF, VOX, FBX or glTF model — a sculpt, a scan, anything — and lay it in bricks at the size you choose

items.name: reference
items.tip: A photo, plan or drawing laid on the floor or stood behind the model, to build over

items.name: flex
items.tip: Lay a hose, a tube, a string or a chain from one connector to another, along a curve

items.name: reshape_flex
items.tip: Drag the selected hose's bend, or put its chain round other sprockets

items.name: part_maker
items.tip: Make a part of your own from the part in hand

items.name: print_part
items.tip: Draw a print on the part selected, printed where it stands, or on the part in hand

items.name: sticker
items.tip: Click a face of the model, then draw the sticker that goes on it

items.name: printed_versions
items.tip: Swap the part for one of the prints or stickered versions the LEGO Group made of it

items.name: tip_held
items.words: Tip the part in hand on its side

items.name: measure
items.tip: A ruler: click two points for the distance in studs, plates and millimetres

items.name: stability
items.tip: Find the joints that would give way, and select the parts on them

items.name: simulate
items.tip: Turn a gear train from a crank or an axle: how fast each part goes, each arm's period, what locks it, and whether it stays standing as it turns

items.name: hidden_colours
items.tip: Give the parts nobody sees in the finished model a colour for each section, stage or side, as big sets do, so you can find your place while building

items.name: reseat
items.tip: Find parts a fraction of a stud off their studs, and offer to seat them

items.name: ask_claude
items.tip: Ask Claude to change the selected parts, and only them, or ask about them

items.name: connector
items.tip: Let Claude build here, from your own Claude account

items.name: settings
items.tip: Which way the wheel zooms, and what the middle button does

items.name: keys
items.tip: What every button and key does

items.name: tour
items.tip: Build your first model, seven short steps done in the app
